method: Reread full primary CDIAL articles and addenda; inspect exact subsection nodes where ambiguity matters. This is a purposive sample, not a complete second scholarly review.
findings: Selected parent and cited primary comparanda supported in all 16 sampled proposals.
4661 moon is a numbered meaning under the same candra head, with no separately promoted 4661-2; retain parent 4661 and exact moon locator.
Bagheli 49 already explicitly preserves gāvā versus gāvī uncertainty; no false certainty added.
Malvi 170 retains the addendum’s evaḍa/kevaḍa extraction analysis, not a direct vṛddha derivation.

before.evidence: CDIAL’s moon sense gives Prakrit *caṃda*, Hindi/Gujarati *cā̃d*, Hindi *candā* and Bhojpuri *cān*. The reduced cluster and nasal/stop variants support the selected forms; longer *candrama* responses are not included.

after.evidence: CDIAL 4661’s moon sense gives Prakrit caṃda, Hindi candā and Sindhi caṇḍru, supporting the lunar family and a nasal-retroflex comparison. Bagheli ceṇḍa/caṇḍ/caṇḍe still need local vowel and cluster correspondence review; Sindhi is a comparison, not a proposed donor.

changes.reason: Make local retroflex cluster/vowel uncertainty explicit; distinguish Sindhi comparison from donor.
